articles.headline: Zachary Bolduc scores decisive goal in shootout for 2nd straight game as Canadiens beat Sabres 4-3
articles.description: — Zachary Bolduc scored the decisive goal in a shootout for the second straight game, and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-3 after blowing a two-goal lead Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Sources: DeBrincat, Red Wings close in on 7-year extension
articles.description: Right wing Alex DeBrincat, 28, Detroit's leading scorer who had two goals and an assist Tuesday in a loss to the New Jersey Devils, is finalizing a new deal with the Red Wings, sources told ESPN, a seven-year contract extension worth $13 million annually.

articles.headline: Svechnikov scores 2 goals to lead the Hurricanes to a 4-2 win over the Capitals
articles.description: — Andrei Svechnikov scored two goals, including the winner with 6:04 left in the third period, to lead the Carolina Hurricanes to a 4-2 win over the Washington Capitals on Tuesday night.
